summary: Enabled allowUnreachableCode: false in tsconfig.base.json and set @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars to { args: "all", argsIgnorePattern: "^_" } in eslint.config.mjs so unreachable code after return and plain unused parameters (leading or trailing) are each owned by one check while underscore-prefixed unused parameters are accepted.
action: Nothing to do by hand for repositories matching the measured baseline (0 hits in fresh Bootstrap, agent-doorway, wiki-personal, and agent-gates main and pull request 1). Template upgrade merges allowUnreachableCode: false into tsconfig.base.json (shared JSON file) and carries the eslint.config.mjs rule update (template-owned file). If a branch has a dead parameter or unreachable statement, remove what is dead or prefix deliberate callback/interface parameters with a leading underscore.
